author: The Thought Emporium
description:
Welcome to the first episode of our new podcast series "We CAN have nice things, actually" where we discuss solutions to the many problems the world is currently struggling with. Often you gain more from solving many small problems, than you do getting bogged down solving 1 bigger problem and ignoring everything else. This first episode focuses on food security and ways that we can make sure everyone is fed. It's actually easier than you'd think. From government programs and community fridges, to multicropping, milpas and chinampas.
